sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding a strong run of form (W-D-W-W-W), host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Alsager arrive in poor shape at the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches and are winless in their last five outings (L-L-L-L-L-W), making this an opportunity for the leaders to extend their advantage.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second place with 20 points, travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, face a tricky assignment at home against Eccleshall, who sit fifth and are unbeaten in their last four (despite their L-W-W-W-W-L record overall). Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, visit Wednesfield Community in a match between mid-table sides. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a clash involving two teams in the upper half. The remaining fixtures see Brereton Social attempt to bounce back against struggling Widnes Town (2 points, on a five-game losing run), Market Drayton Town face New Mills in a low-table encounter, Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town (both near the bottom), Crewe host Allscott Heath, and Shawbury United welcome Barnton—the latter showing promise with back-to-back recent wins despite their precarious league position.
